note: mapping_basis=data_labels. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2014_family.do infixes DA3032 at the ES3032 DATA LIST positions (P1001..P1006 = cols 106-111, identical to ES3032 lines 9-10 and to the questionnaire's column codes (106)-(111)) under lower-cased names, and Bookmark 6 sets item = the variable name (p1001..p1006; lower-casing is Stata naming) -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS vs QUESTIONNAIRE: ES3032 VARIABLE LABELS P1001-P1006 were compared with the P.10 rows of cues3032.pdf read from a 300-dpi render of scanned page 3 (not OCR), dot leaders dropped and hyphenated line breaks rejoined ('su pa-/reja' -- hyphen hidden under the underlined 'a' -- 'posi-/ble', 'esta-/blecer', 'garan-/tizar', 'hi-/jos'): 4/6 agree character for character. TWO DIFFER, and item_text follows the QUESTIONNAIRE (the wording the interviewer read aloud) rather than the label: P1003 questionnaire 'Una muestra de que se quiere de verdad al otro/a' vs label '...al otro'; P1005 questionnaire 'El mejor medio para garantizar los derechos de los hijos' vs label '...de los/as hijos/as'. Both are gender-inflection variants of the same phrase and neither bears on which code is which item -- the label still pins each code to its row, and the questionnaire's column code does so independently. The other four item_text values are the variable labels verbatim (checked in build.R). Items are completions of the stem's '...con que casarse/contraer matrimonio es....?' and ship as printed, unexpanded. VALUE LABELS identical on all 6: 1 'Muy de acuerdo' 2 'Bastante de acuerdo' 3 '(NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' 4 'Poco de acuerdo' 5 'Nada de acuerdo' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.' -- matching the questionnaire's printed list. RESP BY DESIGN: the .do recodes 3 (the volunteered, not-read-out midpoint), 8 and 9 to missing, so live resp is {1,2,4,5} and option rows ship for those four codes only; there is no resp 3 row, and resp keeps its gap (4 = Poco de acuerdo, not the third option). Dropped by the .do, per item p1001..p1006: code 3 = 167/201/206/184/165/228 (1151 total); code 8 = 27/73/35/57/82/68 (342); code 9 = 6/12/9/11/10/11 (59). DA3032 carries no code 0 and no blanks on cols 106-111, so P.10 was asked of all 2464 respondents (it sits under the 'A TODAS LAS PERSONAS ENTREVISTADAS' header before P.9 with no new filter); 18 respondents gave 3/8/9 on all six items and have no rows, which is why live has 2446 ids. CHECKED, decisive: reading DA3032 (2464 records, all 385 bytes; id = row number) at cols 106-111, dropping 3/8/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 254 and cov_age cols 255-256 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 13232 rows both, 2446 ids both, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp and 0 cov_age mismatches; cov_sex stored as the Stata value label (Hombre 6487 rows, Mujer 6745, no cross cells). Live item x resp (1/2/4/5): p1001 697/805/393/369, p1002 321/809/611/437, p1003 518/779/493/424, p1004 101/263/705/1143, p1005 569/1096/291/251, p1006 545/1071/277/264 -- every item uses all four levels; per-item n 2264/2178/2214/2212/2207/2157. Coherence: 'the best way to establish the division of household chores' (p1004, mean 4.1) is the only statement the sample rejects, while 'guaranteeing children's rights' (2.3) and 'a legal commitment expressing a shared life project' (2.4) are the most endorsed. validate_items.R --table-sets passed (6 items, resp {1,2,4,5}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the full P.10 question text verbatim from cues3032.pdf ('Para cada una de las frases que voy a leerle ... con que casarse/contraer matrimonio es....?', four dots as printed), shared by all six rows, so instructions not section_prompt, one trivial section; the '(NO LEER)' marker belongs to the dropped option 3 and is not shipped. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3032 in Spanish only; the _translated columns are English written by this project, option translations aligned with the siblings (Strongly agree / Quite agree / Slightly agree / Do not agree at all) -- issues-page line owed at upload. RIGHTS: instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, 2026-09-22, widened to every CIS survey year 2026-09-23, irw#2381) applied, not re-derived. DESCRIPTION: the IRW dictionary Description ('Agreement that marriage obliges fidelity, makes break-up harder, proves love, is the best way to share housework, guarantees children's rights and expresses a shared life project') names the six P.10 rows in order; no mismatch. Not confused with sibling _marriage (Bookmark 5, P.9, reasons people marry) or _families (Bookmark 7, P.12). No response-data defect.
public_note: The neutral midpoint (volunteered, not read out) was recoded to missing, so resp takes 1, 2, 4, 5 (strongly agree .. do not agree at all) with no 3; items p1003 and p1005 follow the questionnaire's wording, which differs from the CIS variable labels only in gender inflection ('al otro/a' vs 'al otro', 'los hijos' vs 'los/as hijos/as'); item text English is IRW machine translation of the Spanish-only CIS questionnaire
